mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the auth-required fact lets Alloy invent a successful Operation that was never authenticated; the injection forces exactly such an op to exist within scope, so the universal assertion that succeeded implies authenticated must find a counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthBypass { some op: Operation | op.succeeded = True and op.authenticated = False }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing append-only allows two distinct DeletionLogEntry atoms to share the same deletedTaskId; the injection forces that configuration. AppendOnly's pairwise-distinct claim then has a witness counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyDup { some disj e1, e2: DeletionLogEntry | e1.deletedTaskId = e2.deletedTaskId }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the completeness fact allows a successful DeleteTaskKind operation to leave no matching log entry. The injection forces such an op to exist with no entry referencing its target, breaking AuditCompleteness.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingLog { some op: Operation | op.kind = DeleteTaskKind and op.succeeded = True and some op.target and (no e: DeletionLogEntry | e.deletedTaskId = op.target) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the attribution fact allows a log entry whose deleter differs from the actual delete op's caller. The injection forces such a misattributed entry to coexist with a matching successful delete op.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_Misattribution { some op: Operation, e: DeletionLogEntry | op.kind = DeleteTaskKind and op.succeeded = True and op.target = e.deletedTaskId and e.deleter != op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the closed-task fact allows a successful EDIT on a Done task whose body did not simultaneously reopen it. The injection forces precisely that violating shape into the universe.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ClosedEditBypass { some op: Operation | op.kind = EditTaskKind and op.succeeded = True and some op.target and op.target.status = Done and op.bodyReopens = False }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the identity-binding fact allows a successful create whose stored creator does not match the op's authenticated caller (e.g., payload-controlled creator). The injection forces such a mismatch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ImpersonatedCreate { some op: Operation, t: Task | op.kind = CreateTaskKind and op.succeeded = True and op.target = t and t.creator != op.caller }
